implemented_scope: Structural projection of schema inventory only; no catalog instance extraction or instance conformance guarantee.

identity.row_occurrence: Qualify each source row occurrence by source revision, database snapshot, table and extraction occurrence. Do not derive occurrence identity only from its semantic key.
identity.semantic_key: Preserve every original component, component order and field representation independently of occurrence identity.
identity.duplicate_control: Two deliberately duplicated semantic keys remain two row occurrences; compare source and projected occurrence counts.
identity.uuid: Preserve original text. Apply canonicality only according to the individual field and operation contract; do not normalize during projection.
identity.repository_claim: Allow multiple Repository UUID claims for the same common directory. A path or claim does not establish verified Core identity.

bytes.representation: Explicit base64 encoding of original bytes with original byte length
bytes.empty: Empty bytes are present, not SQL NULL or missing; an empty relative path can denote the root.
bytes.round_trip: Decoded bytes must equal original bytes exactly, including non-UTF-8 paths.

native_time_ns.representation: Preserve original decimal TEXT lexeme and explicit nanosecond unit and clock meaning.
native_time_ns.range: May be negative or exceed signed 64-bit; use arbitrary-precision integer comparison only where required.

values.observation_time_us: Keep SQLite INTEGER microsecond fields distinct from native nanosecond TEXT; enforce requiredness and range according to each field, not a universal time shape.

scans.scan_and_outcome: Separate Scan and ScanOutcome nodes. A scan may have zero or one outcome. Missing outcome denotes legitimate incompleteness, not a missing terminal value error.
scans.history: Keep namespace, scan and relative-path composite identity; identical paths in different scans remain distinct observations.
scans.hash_claim: A correctly formed digest and hash status do not prove present real-byte equality or actual scanner execution.

external_references.classification: Qualified external references are distinct from same-database physical foreign keys.
external_references.reference_validation: Validate supplied components even when target instance data is absent.
external_references.unresolved: Required target instance or resolution scope was not supplied; absence alone is not corruption.
external_references.resolved: Only after matching supplied target identity, scope and complete key; never infer from a flag alone.
external_references.namespace: Filesystem and Worktrees namespaces need not match.
external_references.root: A Filesystem scan root may contain a nested worktree root; exact path equality is not required.
external_references.partial_completion: A committed Filesystem scan remains independently valid if execution stops before the Worktrees link is saved.

required_future_controls: SQL NULL versus missing versus empty bytes
duplicate row occurrences with equal semantic keys
optional target absent, matching and mismatching
multiple repository claims and independent namespaces
Filesystem committed before missing Worktrees link
